notes.title: OUT NOW – A Night at the Watermill
notes.content:
[b]Are you ready for a trip the watermill? It might be a trip you will never forget ...[/b]

It's out!!!
We are thrilled to present you our first point and click adventure [b][i]"A Night at the Watermill"[/i][/b]. Explore the gloomy atmosphere and unravel the mysteries of the story. You have lost your memory and are captured in an unfamiliar place: [i]An old watermill. [/i]

Who did this to you? Everything seems strange and dangerous. Can you reveal the secret and escape??

We put a lot of heart in the game and its atmosphere and hope you enjoy your play!
Aaaaand ... did we mention you can also explore and unlock various [b][i]Steam achievements[/i][/b]? Can you find all of them?

For any questions you can join us on [url=https://discord.gg/Dqyt5zWV66]DISCORD[/url]. We'll spent the rest of the evening in the open voice channel!

notes.title: A Night at the Watermill will be out this week!
notes.content:
[b]Finally! This week our game "A Night at the Watermill" will release! Save the date – Friday 26 of January 2024 at 21:23 Uhr (CET)[/b]

Look forward to a point-and-click adventure with a dark atmosphere, great artwork and soundtrack and a captivating story. What happened in the old watermill?!
